Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Checking phone for messages and news about the transport strike
Setting up the home workspace with desk lamp and computer, reviewing the day's program schedule
Working remotely: writing program plans, answering emails and holding online coordination calls for community programs
Cooking lunch with the induction cooker, eating, and loading the dishwasher
Continuing remote work: drafting grant notes and preparing materials for upcoming community activities
Afternoon break, boiling the kettle and making a cup of tea
Finishing remote work tasks and replying to partner organisations online
Tidying up and vacuuming the living room
Relaxing on the sofa and scrolling through phone
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating
Evening walk around the neighbourhood on foot, since public transport is on strike
Showering and getting ready for bed
Wind-down reading and setting an alarm on the phone
